The '''ISB TAC shuttle''',<ref name="WEKAD" /><ref name="JKE">{{Andor|Jedha, Kyber, Erso}}</ref> also known as the '''ISB SWAT Shuttle'''<ref name="YIR 2025">{{SWCT|set=Year in Review - 2025|cardname=ISB SWAT Shuttle}}</ref> or '''ISB SWAT ship''',<ref name="Week 4 Trivia" /> was a type of [[shuttle]] used by the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[ISB Tactical]] [[task force]] for their missions.<ref name="Declassified">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-finale-episodes-10-11-12|text=''Andor'' Explained: Episodes 10-12 - "Make It Stop", "Who Else Knows?", and "Jedha, Kyber, Erso"}}</ref> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="WEKDate">{{AndorDate|211}}</ref> a TAC shuttle designated [[TAC 171]] was used by the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] during a [[Raid on the Axis safehouse|raid on Tomkip Towers]].<ref name="WEKAD">{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ISB TAC shuttle was created for and first appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']] episodes "[[Who Else Knows?]]" and "[[Jedha, Kyber, Erso]]."<ref name="Week 4 Trivia" /><ref name="WEKAD" /><ref name="JKE" /> The ship's design is heavily based on the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lamdba''-class T-4a shuttle]] and [[Abecederian line|other similar ships]].<ref name="Week 4 Trivia" />
